items.title: United Parcel Service (UPS) Appoints Shannon Eisenhardt To Board And Audit Committee
items.summary: United Parcel Service (NYSE: UPS) appointed Shannon Eisenhardt to its Board of Directors and Audit Committee on 5 November 2026. Eisenhardt previously held senior finance and operations roles at Reckitt Benckiser Group and NIKE with a global consumer focus. Her appointment adds boardroom experience in capital allocation, financial oversight and large scale transformation in branded consumer businesses.
